doc.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Jazz is not profitable
summary: Domber says Arbors is unprofitable but keeps jazz alive; a joke about making a million.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: And that’s what keeps jazz alive in my mind. It’s not a profitable operation, the way we do it anyway.
This morning you were saying that jazz is not a profitable operation in fact I think it’s a bit of an oxymoron like the rich jazz musician.
Yeah. That’s right. How do you make a million dollars in the music business? You start with two.
That’s a good one. When you look at the festival here, the jazz convention—
